body: These traces caused elevated span volume when introduced in mobile as noted in this incident channel: https://consensys.slack.com/archives/C0B86CA5FRV/p1786967408967339?thread_ts=1786950903.164589&cid=C0B86CA5FRV We really can't afford a sentry volume spike in the Extension project, and any significant baseline increase would need to be carefully considered. Have we done projections of estimated span volume increase and any factors that might cause fan out? Blocking instrumentation addition until we have a reasonably robust assessment.
action: Audited every tracer call site in perps-controller dist; confirmed a 5-minute preload interval emits 3 spans/tick for every unlocked user in the rollout cohort even when Perps is never opened, so pinned those three transactions to 0.0005 (a tenth of the default) in DEFAULT_TRANSACTION_SAMPLE_RATES.
